paper_title: VISH$ν$: a unified solution to five SM shortcomings with a protected electroweak scale
notes: This is a theoretical model-building paper (VISHnu, a nuDFSZ variant) focused on inflationary dynamics and naturalness. It predicts a preferred axion mass window [40 ueV, ~2 meV] accessible to future haloscope/helioscope searches, but does NOT present a new measured exclusion limit or a computed sensitivity projection curve with (mass, coupling) data. No coupling-vs-mass exclusion data is extractable. The pre-analysis hint of AxionMass does not apply since the paper reports no f_a-m_a exclusion; it only quotes a theoretical mass prediction window. | Coupling from pre-classifier (AxionMass, conf=0.70)
